Subject: Vendor questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ decision and data residency check

Hi Sophie,

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we keep momentum: 

- Use case summary: you confirmed FinBridge will run Redwood for real-time inference on transaction scoring and a pilot for customer support chat. Pilot scope may touch PHI for the upcoming healthcare payments product.
- Compliance priorities you called out: SOC 2 artifacts, GDPR requirements for EU customers, and a HIPAA appendix only if the healthcare pilot proceeds.
- Questionnaire preference: you said you lean toward SIG as the primary deliverable but may need an additional CAIQ or custom field set for procurement.

As discussed, attached is a SIG-lite prefill we put together to speed things up, plus our network diagram for your auditors. Can I confirm the following so we align on the right form?

1) Is FinBridge happy with SIG-lite + HIPAA appendix when applicable, or do you prefer we complete an AICPA CAIQ instead?
2) Data residency: do you require US-only hosting for production, or is US and EU acceptable for pilot/preview?
3) SOC 2: please confirm whether a SOC 2 Type II report is required prior to procurement or whether a SOC 2 in-progress timeline is sufficient.
4) Timeline: you mentioned procurement wants the questionnaire back in two weeks. Please confirm contact for legal procurement so we can route any follow-ups.

If you want, Karthik can run a quick mapping call with your security team to show which SIG sections map to the SOC 2 controls you care about. Proposed next steps: you confirm form choice and residency, we prefill SIG-lite and send a final submission back in 3 business days, then Karthik schedules the mapping call.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Vendor questionnaire: SIG vs CAIQ decision and data residency check

Thanks Evelyn, and thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Form: we do prefer SIG as the canonical questionnaire. Procurement will request a fuller CAIQ only if legal needs more granular control mappings, but start with SIG-lite. Please include a HIPAA appendix template since the payments/healthcare pilot may surface PHI.
- Data residency: production must be US-only. Pilot and dev environments can be multi-region (US + EU) but any EU processing must be GDPR compliant and we will need the data flow diagram called out explicitly.
- SOC 2: we require SOC 2 Type II for production; a SOC 2 Type II in-progress timeline is acceptable to start procurement, but final procurement sign-off will need either the report or an agreed mitigation plan. Our security team will review the prefill and follow up with evidence requests.
- Timeline and contacts: procurement wants the completed SIG within two weeks; procurement contact is Maria Diaz, procurement@finbridge.com. Security lead is security@finbridge.com (external security alias).

I attached our vendor questionnaire with three custom fields we usually require; if you can map those back to SIG sections that will speed the review. Otherwise the plan Karthik suggested sounds good. Let me know if you need a short working session this week.

Best,

Sophie Lang
Head of Partnerships
FinBridge
